FN-TB3B399-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 554
Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs Sponsor: Representative Donna Givens
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/11/2025
House Bill 554 as introduced establishes a new distinctive license plate for motor vehicle
owners who served in a component of the United States Armed Forces and received the Combat
Action Ribbon, Combat Infantryman Badge, Combat Action Badge, or Air Force Combat
Action Medal. The fee for the plate would be the same as for standard vehicles ($23) and there
would be an additional fee of $3 for each plate issued. The standard fee would be distributed as
follows:
State General Fund $10.00
Public Road and Bridge $9.30
Municipalities $2.52
Counties $1.18
Total $23.00
This bill provides criminal penalty for falsely obtaining a military combat action special license
plate and could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from
fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general
funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of
the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and
the penalties imposed.
